:::: {.content-visible when-format="html" when-meta="includes.inventory"}
Set a default view so that you, or everyone in your organization, land on it when opening the inventory. Each record type and each inventory segment has its own defaults.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-format="html" when-meta="includes.artifacts"}
Set a default view so that you, or everyone in your organization, land on it when opening a list of artifacts. Each artifact type has its own defaults.

::::

When you open the list, it displays the first of these that applies to you:

1. Your own default view, if you set one.
2. The organization default view, if it's visible to everyone or to one of your roles.
3. Your own columns, with no view selected.

A default view restricted to roles only opens for users who hold one of those roles. This includes [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} users, who can see every organization view but only land on a role-restricted default if they hold one of its roles. There is one organization default for each list, not one per role.

A link to a specific view or to filtered results always opens what the link points to. If you exit the default view, the list stays without a view until you leave it and come back.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Set your own default view

Your own default overrides the organization default for you only. You can set one of your saved personal views or an organization view as your default. Only one view can be your default for each list.

1. Click on the name of your saved view, or **{{< fa bookmark >}} Select View** if you are not currently displaying a saved view.

2. Select **My Views (#)** or **Organization (#)**.

3. Hover over the name of the view you want to set as your default.

4. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa star >}} Set as My Default**.

The view shows a My default tag. To stop using it as your default, select Remove as My Default from the same menu.

### Set the organization default view

::: {.callout title="Who can set the organization default?"}
To set or remove the organization default, you need permission to publish views to your organization, and you must either have published the view or be a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble}. Only a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} can replace a default view that someone else published.

:::

1. Click on the name of your saved view, or **{{< fa bookmark >}} Select View** if you are not currently displaying a saved view.

2. Select **Organization (#)**.

3. Hover over the view you want to set as the organization default.

4. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa certificate >}} Set as Organization Default**.

The view shows an Org default tag in the list of organization views. The view that was the default before stops being the default.

### Remove the organization default view

1. Click on the name of your saved view, or **{{< fa bookmark >}} Select View** if you are not currently displaying a saved view.

2. Select **Organization (#)**.

3. Hover over the view with the Org default tag.

4. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa certificate >}} Remove as Organization Default**.

Users who have not set their own default view then open the list with no view selected. Unpublishing the default view also removes it as the organization default.

:::
